text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
This is a grave situation...
My clothes are... tight. I have neglected my self-care.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I have to get back to my normal weight
and polish myself up properly!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Looking great, Flight!
That movement just now... was very refined!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Okay, strike your signature pose there!
Keep your eyes on the camera!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I don't have a camera right now, but... somewhere around here, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Nice and nice! Excellent work!
Ah, my producing really is flawless...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Really? Thank you so much!
Hehe. I'm glad I asked you, Royce-chan.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Even the sweat dripping down felt so refreshing...
It turned into such a fun diet session♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Heh... That is wonderful to hear.
I shall also use today's experience as fuel
to better present myself.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Wah. If so, please let me
help out when that time comes.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Let me help you find
your very own unique shine♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Royce and Royce's help,
North Flight seemed to have successfully
returned to her original weight.
